text: Fixed the failing test. `update_fee` in `app/routers/fees.py` changed `amount` and `product_amount` but never updated `balance_amount`, so an unpaid fee kept its old outstanding balance. The patch now applies the change in total (amount + product_amount) to the balance. It does this only when the fee isn't already paid and the caller didn't set `balance_amount` or `status` explicitly. The balance is clamped at zero. The target test passed (1 passed), and the full `tests/` directory passed (30 passed).
